newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut bourse bullish on Solidere shares.
newsitem.headline: Beirut bourse bullish on Solidere shares.

text.p: The Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday was bullish on Solidere shares which rose in strong demand after recent profit-taking brought them down from two-year highs.
The LIBX bank index climbed 0.56 percent to 189.5. The BLOM general index rose 3.27 percent to 1094.13 and the LISPI general index increased 0.88 percent to 95.60.
BSE turnover rose to 319,897 from 307,715 for a value of $3,915,546 against $3,946,694.
Solidere A and B shares both rose to $12.75 from $12.25. Last Tuesday, the shares hit $13.75.
"The market is bullish now on Solidere because it has reached its lowest acceptable level. I think it will ameliorate," said a broker who requested anonymity.
Banque Audi maintained its record high of $28.75 and Bank of Beirut climbed to $4.875 from $4.6875. Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce fell to $22 from $22.5.
"Audi should get better and will stay in the range of $28.50 to $29.00 this week," the broker added.
There was no trade in the other three industrial firms -- Ciments Blanc, Eternit and Uniceramic
